Street wear from Brick Lane – limited drops from small labels that stay honest.

Our story

From a market stall

Sprint began in 2017 as a Sunday stall on Brick Lane selling printed hoodies. The labels we stocked were small, the runs were short – and people queued for them.

Today we're a shop and a studio, but we still drop a new capsule every Friday.

Questions

Frequently asked

How do your hoodies fit?

Oversized – take your usual size for a relaxed fit.

When is the next drop?

Every Friday at 10 am – sign up for the drop email.

Will a sold-out item come back?

Rarely – most drops are one run only.

Do you ship abroad?

To the EU and US, 3 – 6 working days.

Which payment methods do you take?

Visa, Mastercard, PayPal and Apple Pay.

Can I change my order?

Within an hour – call +44 20 7946 0222.
